zh: 补齐技能、插件脚本与内置工具全链路服务端及对话真控制：12 个业务页面按当前状态默认开放且超管可随时收回/恢复，基础设施页持续锁定仅超管可用，导航、首页、Skill Hub、API、数据库工具与指南检索同步生效。
修复 AI 月报非交互格子在 validateInteractive 环节无条件拦截导致死循环重试的故障，兼容顶层配方 JSON、排除“不需要/排除 EOS”等否定词反向召回，并精简 /run-data 诊断日志冗余体积与补全 TPS/模型统计。
移动端（iOS / Android）新增工具自适应桌面/窄屏视口与缩放支持、Markdown 解析与媒体组件增强，同步优化移动端工具页独立加载与快捷方式体验。
en: Enforced real server-side, UI, and Dragon Claw AI access control across Skills, Plugins & Scripts, and built-in tools: preserves existing open state for the 12 business pages while allowing super-admins to revoke or re-open any item at any time.

Fixed AI Monthly Report infinite retry loops on non-interactive cells in validateInteractive, added top-level recipe JSON compatibility, excluded negated terms (e.g. 'exclude EOS') from metric recall, and trimmed duplicated /run-data trace bloat.
Mobile (iOS / Android) updates: adaptive tool viewport scaling via detected mobile layout, enhanced Markdown parser and chat media components, and streamlined standalone tool navigation.
